now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#6
now.text: Mack and Jemma Simmons become close friends on Coulson's team.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend on Coulson's team.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend on Coulson's team.

proposed.text: Mack tells Jemma Simmons that he only knows the new Fitz and thinks Fitz is better off without her around, and she tearfully agrees.

changes.evidence: In A Fractured House (S2#6) their only exchange is Mack telling Simmons he does not remember the old Fitz, only knows this one, and feels this one is better without her; she tearfully agrees. 'Become close friends' sums up a later through-line rather than what happens between them here.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#9
now.text: Ward later comes for Raina and takes her to Hydra.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Inhuman Ward comes for and takes to Hydra.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Hydra agent who comes for Raina and takes her to Hydra.

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A woman Ward comes for and takes to Hydra.

changes.evidence: At ...Ye Who Enter Here (S2#9) Raina has not yet gone through Terrigenesis; she transforms in What They Become (S2#10). Calling her 'Inhuman' on the S2#9 card gives away the later transformation.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#9
now.text: Lance Hunter helps guard Raina from Hydra in Vancouver, and when she tries to surrender to Hydra, he and May drive her clear. Earlier, his attempt to kill Carl Creel creates the chaos Raina uses to slip away with the Diviner.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A woman Hunter helps guard from Hydra in Vancouver.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who helps guard Raina from Hydra in Vancouver.

proposed.text: Lance Hunter helps guard Raina from Hydra in Vancouver, and when she tries to surrender to Hydra, he and May drive her clear.

changes.evidence: The second sentence describes Heavy Is the Head (S2#2): Raina steals the Diviner during the commotion Hunter causes trying to assassinate Creel. That is another episode's event in an S2#9 stage; the first sentence covers the Vancouver events of ...Ye Who Enter Here.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#10
now.text: Trip dies in the Kree city trying to pull Skye away from the Obelisk as the Terrigen Mist transforms her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Trip's friend, whom he dies trying to pull from the Obelisk.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Daisy's friend, who dies trying to pull her from the Obelisk.

proposed.text: Trip follows Skye into the sealed Kree temple and dies trying to save her, kicking the Diviner off its pedestal as the mist transforms her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Trip's friend, whom he dies trying to save in the Kree temple.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Daisy's friend, who dies trying to save her in the Kree temple.

changes.evidence: In What They Become (S2#10) Trip does not pull Skye away: trapped in the temple as she is cocooned, he kicks the Diviner from its pedestal to stop it, a crystal shard embeds in him and he turns to stone. The card lines repeat the 'pull from the Obelisk' error.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#10
now.text: Trip helps guard Raina from Daniel Whitehall in Vancouver. He then follows Skye and Raina into the sealed Kree temple and dies trying to stop the Diviner from transforming them.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A woman Trip guards, then dies trying to stop in the Kree temple.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who guards Raina, then dies in the Kree temple.

proposed.text: Trip follows Skye and Raina into the sealed Kree temple and dies trying to stop the Diviner from transforming them.

changes.evidence: Trip guards Raina in Vancouver in ...Ye Who Enter Here (S2#9), not What They Become (S2#10). The only stage is on S2#10, where the temple death happens; moving it to S2#9 would put the death early, so the fix is dropping the S2#9 event from the text (card lines stay true).
